lines.text: The psalm gives glory to the LORD's name, and says our God is in heaven and does as He pleases.
The nations' idols are made of silver and gold by human hands, yet they cannot speak, see, or hear.
Idol makers become like their idols, but Israel, Aaron's house, and those who fear the LORD are told to trust.
The LORD will bless Israel and the house of Levi, and the blessing comes from heaven and earth's Maker.
The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but He gave the earth to priests, and we will bless Him forevermore.
